Probably we need to call the function twice: one for Tenet at 5pm, one for No Time To Die at 7:30pm. But the user wants two theaters that have both showtimes? Could be interpreted as find two theaters that each have those showtimes. But likely they want two theaters: one for Tenet at 5pm, one for No Time To Die at 7:30pm. We'll call function twice.
